messages:
Elaine-partners: FYI urgent — multiple customers reporting that merchant portal PO batch ACKs are delayed/backlogged, blocking downstream invoicing for a queued marketplace deal :rotating_light:
Mike-ops: seeing the same alerts, queue depth spiking for EDI-ACK processor since midnight UTC
Alec-engineering: looking into the consumer microservice now, can you paste an example PO ID that's stuck?
Elaine-partners: PO: PO-ACME-7881, vendor: NovaEdge, customer: ZephyrCloud — vendor portal shows 'pending ack' while our API returned 200 earlier
po-ops-bot: Automated alert: edi_ack_retry_count(PO-ACME-7881)=7, last_retry=2026-03-21T22:05:32Z
Alec-engineering: quick log snippet from the processor:
```
ERROR processing ack batch: downstream timeout to vendor-novaedge.com/api/acks (504)
batch_id=bn-20260321-334, retries=5, consumer_offset=12842
Response body: {"error":"gateway timeout"}
```
Mike-ops: vendor endpoint intermittently timing out, but also we have a backlog in the ack queue causing exponential retry storms
Vendor-support: we've got a ticket open with NovaEdge CS — they confirm a deployment yesterday that increased CPU on their gateway; they said they're rolling a fix now, ETA ~1h
Natalie-sales: we have two live prospects in the pipeline waiting on those POs to clear — can we prioritize merchant portal ACKs for enterprise customers?
Sam-legal: FYI some of these POs include negotiated payment terms; if they stay in limbo >72h we need to alert finance/legal for contract risk
Alec-engineering: short-term mitigation I can do: pause exponential retries and switch to linear backoff for merchant-portal route + enable per-customer priority processing for enterprise IDs (will take ~25m to deploy a canary)
Mike-ops: please also add a rule to route a small % of traffic to the legacy ack processor (less aggressive) as fallback
Elaine-partners: agree — prioritize AcmeCloud/ZephyrCloud and any deals >$100k, thank you
Alec-engineering: deploying canary now to staging -> will promote to prod after smoke tests, posting results in 10m
po-ops-bot: Deploy started: deploy-ack-backoff-canary by alec-engineering at 2965432590
Alec-engineering: smoke: ok on staging, can see linear backoff applied and queue drain rate improved ~3x
Mike-ops: rolling canary to 10% prod, watching metrics (queue depth, retry_count, 5xx)
Vendor-support: NovaEdge reports their gateway fix is live, they cleared some pending webhooks; they recommend we replay ACKs after our queue stabilizes
Alec-engineering: replay script ready, will replay PO batches for priority customers after queue < 1000
Elaine-partners: can we get a short note to the customers — ZephyrCloud and AcmeCloud — that we're on it and expected clear in ~2 hours? I'll draft
Natalie-sales: I'll send the outreach once you confirm queue drain and replays complete
Sam-legal: please log the incident and flag any POs >$250k for manual review if replay fails
Alec-engineering: queue is dropping, replaying batch bn-20260321-334 -> ack accepted for PO-ACME-7881, vendor returned 202 Accepted
Mike-ops: metrics look healthy, retry_count trending to zero, promoting canary to 50% then full if stable
Elaine-partners: sending customer update now. Thanks team :pray:
Vendor-support: NovaEdge confirms they processed backlog on their side; monitoring for 30m
Alec-engineering: canary promoted to 100% at 2965433480, final smoke OK
po-ops-bot: Incident resolved: ack-backlog cleared at 2965433600
Elaine-partners: closing thread — followups: create postmortem, add permanent priority route for enterprise marketplace POs, and schedule a sync with NovaEdge next week to avoid future deploy collisions
